sections.introduction: Aghornarsingha rasa is an herbomineral formulation consisting of many herbs and minerals. The ingredients of this medicine are well known for their effective antipyretic action, cold action, and anti-diarrheal actions along with effects in chronic cough conditions.
sections.ingredients:

 Swarnamakshika Bhasma – 1 part 
 Shuddha Mainshila – 1 part 
 Krishnasarpa Visha – 4 parts 
 Shuddha Kuchla – 22 parts 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha – 88 parts 
 Tamra Bhasma – 1 part 
 Loha Bhasma – 2 parts

sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Trikatu Churna (Powder of three herbs having hot potency) – The combination of sonth ( Zingiber officinale ), maricha ( Piper nigrum ) and pippali (Piper longum). This medicine is very much beneficial in improving digestion and is widely used as analgesic, anti-inflammatory and blood purifier. 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha (Detoxified form of Aconitum ferox ) is the best herb used for swedojanan (induce sweating), and thus acting as the best antipyretic. Also other properties include ama pachak (detoxifier), mucolytic, diuretic etc. 
 Shuddha Kuchla ( Strychnos nuxvomica ) pacify vata and kapha dosha having properties like antihelminthic, diuretic in action, good appetizer, digestive stimulant, a helpful tonic in nervous disorders. 

 Method of Preparation 
 Make a kajjali (homogenous mixture) of Parada and Gandhak in a kharal  yantra. Then mix mainshila and other bhasma in that kharal yantra along with kajjali. After that, give proper frolement to above mentioned powders.  After that give 1 proper mix to them with the gallbladder (bile) of rohit fish, buffalo, peacock or pig. After that give a final mix with nirgundi patra swaras (fresh juice extract of Vitex negundo ) and chitrak mool kwath (decoction made from roots of Plumbago zeylanica ). And then make the tablets as big as the size of mustard and dry it in the sunlight. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 This medicine contains a lot of ingredients that are antipyretic in nature. When this medicine is given with coconut milk in case of chronic fever conditions (visham sannipat jwar), visuchka and atisaar (chronic diarrheal conditions), it gives immediate relief. It can be used in excessive thirst and burning sensation related cases with the coconut milk. This rasa is also termed as rasanamuttmo rasah (i.e. the best among all the rasa medicines).

13 types of Sannipataja jwara ( chronic fevers) 
 Cholera

 Burning sensations in hands and feet

 Burning sensation in abdomen
sections.dosage: 1 tablet once a day (10 mg) with coconut milk.
sections.contraindications:
Avoided during pregnancy or lactation periods. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikarah 5/711-718 
 Introduction 
 Aghornarsingha rasa is an herbomineral formulation consisting of many herbs and minerals. The ingredients of this medicine are well known for their effective antipyretic action, cold action, and anti-diarrheal actions along with effects in chronic cough conditions.

 Shuddha Kuchla – 22 parts 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha – 88 parts 
 Tamra Bhasma – 1 part 
 Loha Bhasma – 2 parts 
 Abhrak Bhasma – 4 parts 
 Shuddha Parada – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak – 1 part 
 Trikatu – 4 parts 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Trikatu Churna (Powder of three herbs having hot potency) – The combination of sonth ( Zingiber officinale ), maricha ( Piper nigrum ) and pippali (Piper longum). This medicine is very much beneficial in improving digestion and is widely used as analgesic, anti-inflammatory and blood purifier.

 Shuddha Kuchla ( Strychnos nuxvomica ) pacify vata and kapha dosha having properties like antihelminthic, diuretic in action, good appetizer, digestive stimulant, a helpful tonic in nervous disorders.

 Make a kajjali (homogenous mixture) of Parada and Gandhak in a kharal  yantra. Then mix mainshila and other bhasma in that kharal yantra along with kajjali. After that, give proper frolement to above mentioned powders.  After that give 1 proper mix to them with the gallbladder (bile) of rohit fish, buffalo, peacock or pig. After that give a final mix with nirgundi patra swaras (fresh juice extract of Vitex negundo ) and chitrak mool kwath (decoction made from roots of Plumbago zeylanica ). And then make the tablets as big as the size of mustard and dry it in the sunlight. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 This medicine contains a lot of ingredients that are antipyretic in nature. When this medicine is given with coconut milk in case of chronic fever conditions (visham sannipat jwar), visuchka and atisaar (chronic diarrheal conditions), it gives immediate relief. It can be used in excessive thirst and burning sensation related cases with the coconut milk. This rasa is also termed as rasanamuttmo rasah (i.e. the best among all the rasa medicines). 
 Indications 
 
 13 types of Sannipataja jwara ( chronic fevers) 
 Cholera 
 Diarrheal fever 
 Burning sensations in hands and feet 
 Thirst 
 Burning sensation in abdomen 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet once a day (10 mg) with coconut milk.

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
